description: This file defines a class for emitting CUDA kernel templates for GEMM operations using NVIDIA's CUTLASS library, including methods for generating code snippets for different GEMM configurations and handling complex data types and mixed precision modes.

classes.name: EmitGemmUniversal3xInstanceWithEVT
classes.description: Responsible for emitting CUDA kernel template definitions for GEMM operations using CUTLASS.

methods.name: pointerize_if_grouped
methods.description: Returns layout pointer type, adding '*' if the operation is grouped.

methods.name: problem_shape
methods.description: Determines the shape type for the GEMM problem, considering grouping.

methods.name: emit
